notes.title: Version 1.2a - Performance Updates
notes.notes:
Updated to version 1.2a.  This has fixed a few bugs that I've been emailed about.  More importantly, it contains some optimized updates for the C# side of the house.

Please let me know if you have any issues!  I'm working on an update to the Air biome next!

notes.title: Version 1.1 - New Creature!
notes.notes:
Added a new creature called Poly!  This little dude will float along asteroids trying to find their way into your entrances.  Put some doors up before they get in and try not to get too close!

I also fixed the bug where the tutorial text was hidden.  Thanks to Steam user sourceofpain for that one!
